Package domain

Class ArcadeMode

java.lang.Object
domain.GameMode
domain.ArcadeMode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ArcadeMode extends GameMode
Arcade: a match between the two chosen characters, by time or by goals. In survival it is a series against the machine: while the left player wins, a new match is played.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

      public ArcadeMode(GameCharacter leftCharacter, Stats leftStats, PlayerController leftController, GameCharacter rightCharacter, Stats rightStats, PlayerController rightController, MatchType type, String resolution, BallSkin skin, String stadium)
      Keeps the configuration of the game.
      Parameters:
      leftCharacter - character of the left player
      leftStats - stats of the left player
      leftController - who controls the left player
      rightCharacter - character of the right player
      rightStats - stats of the right player
      rightController - who controls the right player
      type - rule to end the match
      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"
      skin - ball to play with
      stadium - stadium of the match ("default", "rain"...)
